2607.15163.title: Scaling Behavior Foundation Model for Humanoid Robots
2607.15163.paper_summary: Humanoid control requires natural whole-body coordination, precise real-time responses to control signals, and robust generalization across diverse environmental contexts, making it a cornerstone for generalist embodied agents. Behavior Foundation Models (BFMs) have recently emerged as a promising solution to address these challenges by leveraging large-scale behavioral data to achieve superior expressiveness, versatility and generalization. However, despite growing interest in scaling BFMs to further improve their capabilities, it remains unclear how key factors, including the learning paradigm, behavioral data and model architecture should be coordinated to enable effective scaling. In this work, we revisit the scaling recipe for BFMs and demonstrate that substantial performance gains can be achieved through the coordination of three core components: 1) the learning paradigm of motion tracking that reformulates diverse humanoid control problems as the reproduction of integrated whole-body behaviors in the global frame; 2) the strategic synergy between on-policy rollout quantity and reference motion diversity; and 3) the expressive and scalable model architecture termed Humanoid Transformer that facilitates the natural emergence of structured behavioral representations. Through extensive experiments in both simulation and real-world deployment, we demonstrate that our approach yields significant improvements in control fidelity and task generalization, reducing Mean Per-Keypoint Position Error (MPKPE) on the test set by over 10% in local mode and 82% in global mode compared with existing humanoid controllers. These results establish BFM as a principled and effective foundation for scalable and general-purpose humanoid control.
2607.15163.paper_summary_zh: 人形控制需要自然的全身協調、對控制信號的精確即時反應，以及在多樣環境背景下的穩健泛化，這使其成為通用具身代理的基石。行為基礎模型（BFMs）最近作為一種有前景的解決方案出現，旨在通過利用大規模行為數據來實現卓越的表現力、多樣性和泛化能力。然而，儘管對擴展BFMs以進一步提升其能力的興趣日益增長，但仍不清楚如何協調關鍵因素，包括學習範式、行為數據和模型架構，以實現有效擴展。在這項工作中，我們重新審視BFMs的擴展配方，並展示通過協調三個核心組件可以實現顯著的性能提升：1）運動跟踪的學習範式，將多樣的人形控制問題重新表述為在全局框架中再現整合的全身行為；2）在線策略展開數量和參考運動多樣性之間的戰略協同；以及3）稱為人形Transformer的表現力和可擴展模型架構，促進結構化行為表徵的自然出現。通過在模擬和實際部署中的廣泛實驗，我們展示了我們的方法在控制精度和任務泛化方面帶來了顯著的改善，與現有的人形控制器相比，測試集上的每個關鍵點位置誤差（MPKPE）在本地模式下降低了超過10%，在全局模式下降低了82%。這些結果確立了BFM作為可擴展和通用人形控制的原則性和有效基礎。
